title: Hip East Nashville Home with Rooftop Patio
description:
Unwind in this hip East Nashville townhome. Large windows on every floor provide loads of natural light, while the primary bathroom has a double vanity and dreamy double-headed shower. Relax downstairs by playing classics on the turntable.

Best suited for couples or small groups. It is not meant to be used as a party home and unauthorized events are strictly prohibited.

The space
- 2 comfortable queen beds, 2.5 bathrooms (& the primary bath has a GIANT walk-in shower!).
- First floor: bedroom & garage, Second Floor: living/kitchen/dining, Third floor: primary suite & deck
- Open concept floor plan for kitchen/living/dining area. Kitchen is ideal for entertaining and cooking with a giant island with barstools and plenty of counter space.
- Secluded rooftop deck space with string lights, perfect for drinking wine on!
- Huge natural windows on every floor provide lots of great light.
- Smart TV with access to apps for streaming - no cable.
- Washer and dryer in unit.
- For those bringing vehicles, there are three options for parking: a private attached single-car garage, a shared lot out back for townhouse use only, and street parking in front.
- Located off two major streets, but it is well sound-proofed and quiet. Being so close to various big streets makes getting around town a breeze.
- Uber/Lyft rides to downtown are around 10 minutes. 
- Please note: my home has two full staircases, so you must be comfortable going up and down stairs if you choose to book.
- This property is dog friendly and without a fees, but please disclose when bringing a dog. 

Additional Notes:
- Please treat this property with respect as if it is your own. I am certain you will adore it as much as I do! 
- The entire place will be yours for the duration of your stay. 
- No smoking allowed, no exceptions. Automatic $500 charge for those who smoke inside.
- Extra guests will be considered for a $150 charge per additional person, per night.
- No loud music. 
- No glitter (if found, it's an automatic $350 charge).

I am available via phone and text throughout the course of your stay. If for some reason I cannot be, I will have a co-host and more information for you prior to your check-in. I do not stay in my house when you rent it.

Walk to well-known bars such as The Fox, Mickey's, and Living Waters Brewing, with the many destinations of Five Points under a 5-minute drive, and downtown not much further. Be sure to check the guidebook for further recommendations.

Guest access
The entire place will be yours for the duration of your stay.

Other things to note
- I have a doorbell camera and two exterior cameras outside the garage. I installed them only because I had a package stolen off my stoop last year, but I do not tune in or use it unless there is an important reason to.
